import hashlib,io,json,os,subprocess,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
cases=[
 ('未裁剪第一项','min(v, 10000) for v in values','min(v, 10000) if i else v for i, v in enumerate(values)','test_luffy_clamps_only_upper_bounds'),
 ('上界少一','min(v, 10000) for v in values','min(v, 9999) for v in values','test_luffy_clamps_only_upper_bounds'),
 ('允许零肉块','min(values) >= 1','min(values) >= 0','test_luffy_clamps_only_upper_bounds'),
 ('漏掉首个旧用例',"(str(len(rows))+'\\n').encode() + payload","(str(len(rows)-1)+'\\n').encode() + payload.split(b'\\n',1)[1]",'test_cinema_restores_count_preserves_all_cases_and_layout'),
 ('错加一组',"(str(len(rows))+'\\n').encode() + payload","(str(len(rows)+1)+'\\n').encode() + payload",'test_cinema_restores_count_preserves_all_cases_and_layout'),
 ('允许零坐标','row[1] > 0 and row[2] > 0','row[1] >= 0 and row[2] >= 0','test_cinema_restores_count_preserves_all_cases_and_layout'),
 ('不校已有组数','assert int(header[0]) == len(rows)','assert True','test_cinema_restores_count_preserves_all_cases_and_layout'),
 ('删除错误概率','extra = spans[-1]','extra = spans[0]','test_synthesis_removes_only_out_of_triangle_cell'),
 ('允许概率超出1','0 <= p <= 1','0 <= p <= 2','test_synthesis_rejects_unknown_schema_unreachable_or_ties'),
 ('不检查最优唯一','choices and choices.count(min(choices)) == 1','choices','test_synthesis_rejects_unknown_schema_unreachable_or_ties'),
 ('扩大未审核的多余列修复','n == 10 and i == 8 and len(row) == 10','len(row) == i + 2','test_synthesis_rejects_unknown_schema_unreachable_or_ties')]
p=Path('scripts/gmyhf_review_fixes.py');original=p.read_text();results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_legacy_inputs.LegacyInputTests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(original)
finally:p.write_text(original)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));from tests import test_gmyhf_legacy_inputs as tests
for n,name,old,new,test in [
 (19965,'肉块消耗向下取整','(a + b - 1) // b','a // b','test_luffy_reference_against_all_meat_consumption_choices'),
 (19974,'边界反射错误加回','total - (math.comb','total + (math.comb','test_cinema_reference_against_lattice_paths_on_both_sides'),
 (19984,'五成双误用一律进位','cents % 2','True','test_synthesis_reference_against_credit_equation_and_decimal_rounding')]:
 proof=next(e for e in json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-pending-batch8-review.json').read_text())['entries'] if e['global_number']==n)['authored_reference'];source=proof['source'].split('import sys\nsys.stdout.write')[0];assert source.count(old)==1
 ns={};exec(source.replace(old,new),ns);function={19965:'luffy',19974:'cinema',19984:'synthesis'}[n]
 with patch.object(tests,'reference',return_value=ns[function]):
  run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.LegacyInputTests(test));assert not run.wasSuccessful(),name
 results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch17-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':17,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码已恢复')
